## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section (unflagged) with a confident invasive prediction [F1] and suggested positive superior/inferior margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive probability (risk 99%) |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target coverage (alpha 0.10) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability; 92nd OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Unflagged input; elevated OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (81%–86% similarity) [F5]; contrast Benign (76%) | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Dominant driver (+2.10 contribution; score 1.73, above typical) [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.19; down-weighted concept) adds +0.42 toward invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.65; down-weighted concept) adds +0.39 toward invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Low standardized score (-0.56; down-weighted concept) adds +0.37 · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · Score 1.14 adds +0.25, but failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.001 vs random, 95% CI -0.009 to 0.006); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated frozen-section stain degradation (severity 3, 92nd OOD percentile) misleads the classifier; reliability error AUROC is 0.70.
- Apparent stromal infiltration mimics Benign contrast case `BACH_0284` (76% similarity, differs in invasion and tubules).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 10, 11**: Verify true stromal invasion versus frozen-section artifact and check loss of duct confinement.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 9**: Inspect superior (x=1280, y=0) and inferior (x=768, y=1280) margins for tumor within 108 um.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 7, 8**: Check nuclear pleomorphism and residual tubules; follow-up stains are blocked on frozen sections.
